newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITI says not worried about rise in Japan surplus.
newsitem.headline: MITI says not worried about rise in Japan surplus.

text.p: Japan's Vice Minister for International Trade and Industry Tsutomu Makino said on Thursday he was not worried about rises in the nation's overall trade surplus at the moment.
"I know some countries are concerned about rises in Japan's trade surplus but I am not so worried at this point," he told a news conference.
Asked if this meant he was not worried that Japanese manufacturers would embark on an export drive, he said: "Yes, that's right."
